2. External Partners (Flinders, DICT, RCH, etc.): Run Draft-Delegate Protocol—check calendar, generate pending Gmail drafts in aset@google.com signed as 'Ms. Agenica S', and send Chat notifications with 1-click links to send.
description: Handles internal autonomous execution (HITL) and external Draft-Delegate email workflows for Ms. Agenica S.
